description: One sprint as the Sprint Summary view counts it: delivered items and points, cycle time, carryover, and commitment (committed at the end of day one, completed of committed, reliability, scope added and removed). Answers with numbers, dates, states and work item ids only; never work item titles, descriptions, comments, tags or assigned people, and never calls Baytek. Uses the customer’s saved workflow mapping only; no mapping answers {"error":"workflow-not-mapped"}. {"error":"licence-inactive"} means the organisation’s trial has ended without a valid licence, or its licence has not been confirmed for 30 days: tell the person to open Agile Analytics in Azure DevOps and, if the answer stays the same, to ask an admin to look at Configuration → License. {"error":"no-seat"} means the plan gives Agile Analytics to assigned people only and this person has no seat: tell them to open Agile Analytics in Azure DevOps once and ask again and, if the answer stays the same, to ask an extension admin for a seat (Configuration → Access Control). {"error":"throttled"} or {"error":"timed-out"}: wait a minute and ask again.

sprintId.description: Iteration GUID. Default: the last finished sprint (a running sprint is never summarised by default).
